sources.provenance: NOAA/AOML WP-3D tail Doppler radar merged analyses distributed through TC-ATLAS

R1_vertical_alignment.raw_measure: tc_tilt_magnitude near 8 km divided by max(tc_rmw near 2 km, 10 km)

R2_tangential_column_coherence.raw_measure: median Pearson correlation between 2-km radial tangential-wind profile and profiles near 4, 6, and 8 km, using 0-150 km radius in fixed 15-km annuli

R3_vorticity_column_coherence.raw_measure: median cosine similarity between positive-vorticity radial profiles near 2 km and profiles near 4, 6, and 8 km, using 0-100 km radius in fixed 20-km annuli

R4_inflow_outflow_coupling.raw_measure: minimum of inner-core low-level convergence magnitude and upper-level divergence magnitude; low level = mean near 2 and 4 km, upper level = mean near 8 and 10 km, radius <=100 km

R5_convective_vertical_continuity.raw_measure: mean fraction of >=20 dBZ pixels near 2 km within radius <=100 km that remain >=20 dBZ at the same horizontal locations near 6 and 8 km

normalization: Each relation is transformed to a [0,1] empirical calibration-period percentile in its frozen coherence direction. Holdout outcomes are never used for normalization.

temporal_variables.M_t: C_t minus previous same-storm C_t when prior radar case is 6-36 h earlier
temporal_variables.dA_t: A_t minus previous same-storm A_t under the same interval rule
temporal_variables.component_deltas: current normalized relation score minus previous same-storm score under the same interval rule

state_history_environment_comparator: shdc_ships(0h) or shgc_ships(0h) if shdc unavailable

models.STRUCTURAL_COMPONENT: five normalized relation scores plus five component deltas
models.COMBINED_COMPONENT: BASE plus all relation scores and component deltas

fit: StandardScaler plus L2 logistic regression; all model fitting restricted to 2004-2018 calibration observations.
noncompensation_specificity_test: compare COMBINED_NONCOMP against COMBINED_ADDITIVE and COMBINED_COMPONENT on the same holdout
secondary_metrics: matched-state high-C versus low-C RI risk difference

eligibility.required: complete outcome, BASE variables, all five raw relation measures, and a previous same-storm radar case 6-36 h earlier for the primary C_t/M_t test
eligibility.missing: UNEVALUABLE for the affected model; no imputation

terminal_rules.RAW_TC_RADAR_MECHANISTIC_SUPPORTED_WITH_: primary incremental AUC > 0 and storm-cluster 95% CI lower bound > 0, with COMBINED_NONCOMP not inferior to both additive comparators
terminal_rules.STRUCTURAL_SIGNAL_PRESENT_NONCOMPENSATOR: primary incremental AUC > 0 with CI lower bound > 0, but an additive comparator has greater holdout AUC than COMBINED_NONCOMP
terminal_rules.RAW_TC_RADAR_SIGNAL_PRESENT_INCONCLUSIVE: primary incremental AUC > 0 but storm-cluster 95% CI includes 0
terminal_rules.RAW_TC_RADAR_MECHANISTIC_UNEVALUABLE: holdout lacks both outcome classes or fewer than 10 primary evaluable holdout observations

claim_ceiling: bounded retrospective evidence about internal hurricane structural organization and 24-h rapid intensification; does not by itself establish causality, prospective operational utility, independently recovered constitutive routes, or universality
